[[File:Profane Scabarite icon.png|left]]
'''Elite Profane Scabarites''' are a stronger version of [[Profane Scabarite]]s located in the [[Temple of Isolation]] after completing the [[Beneath Scabaras' Sands]] quest. They will summon a [[Spirit Scarab]] during combat if they are able to hit the player, as well as dealing heavy poison damage. The [[Venomblood]] perk, [[anti-poison totem]] or [[antipoison]]s are recommended.

Compared to their non-elite counterparts, elite scabarites have slightly better drops, removing some of the less desirable drops such as jewellery and mithril salvage, while other shared drops are given in larger amounts.

Killing 200 of them with a [[primed keris]] equipped is required to upgrade it to [[consecrated keris]], which earns the achievement [[Another One Scabarites The Dust]], a [[master quest cape]] requirement.

==Locations==
Found in the [[Temple of Isolation]] underneath the Kharidian desert. To reach the temple, simply travel by the [[old boat]] in the [[Scabarite Cavern]] after completion of [[Beneath Scabaras' Sands]] The boat is at the south side of the cave. The mobs in the cave are aggressive.
